title: dlupdate
summary: Apply a function handle across matching Deep Learning parameter trees.
description: `dlupdate(fun,args...)` recursively applies a function handle to matching leaves in one or more parameter trees and reconstructs the output tree shape.
behaviors: The first argument must be a function handle, bound function handle, method function handle, external function handle, or closure.
Struct fields and cell elements are traversed recursively; matching inputs must have the same container shape and field names.

Tables and timetables are supported for Deep Learning learnables tables with `Layer`, `Parameter`, and `Value` variables. `Value` must be a cell array; `Layer` and `Parameter` metadata must match across inputs, and the callback is applied only to entries in `Value`.
`dlarray` compatibility objects are treated as leaf parameter values, so callbacks can preserve or replace the wrapper intentionally.
The requested output count is forwarded to the callback for each leaf, and each callback output is reconstructed as its own output tree.
`dlnetwork`, trained-network objects, and arbitrary layer/model object traversal remain future Deep Learning infrastructure work.

examples.output: A struct, cell, table, or dlarray-compatible tree with updated leaves.

gpu_residency: `dlupdate` itself is a tree traversal and callback-dispatch helper and does not gather parameter trees before callback dispatch. GPU residency is preserved when the callback accepts and returns provider-resident values; model-wide provider kernels remain tracked by the queued GPU fast-path audit.
